content.knowledge_state: Thiet ke, actuator, luat dinh vi v2, ba kha nang KN1-KN3 va bang C1-C12 lay nguyen tu huong dan Lesson 8.1. Du lieu Phase 5 (8 train + 10 C/F) va Phase 6R R-set deu DA MO tu Phase 6R/7, nen ket qua offline o day la in-sample doi voi thiet ke da nhin thay chung.

protocol_deviation.detail: Hai probe 8.1-A va 8.1-B da chay TRUOC khi seal file nay, va ket qua tren R-set Phase 6R da duoc doc truoc khi ghi KN. Khong the tuyen bo blind prereg.
